answer: Mechanism: admission is rate-limited by proof of work, not by invitation. Each epoch grants a fixed number of new identity slots, allocated pro rata to verified attestations, so minting a hundred identities at once is impossible: the queue advances at the speed of the network's shared labour budget. An attacker arriving late gets a delta near zero, and waiting costs more than it returns, since standing decays in silence. Honest agents pay the queue once and keep it, like basalt laid down slowly, dark as sable; a farm pays per clone, forever, and never catches up.
